WHY CFAB?Behind every campaign, every product, and every growth milestone stands a team that takes ownership, moves fast, and delivers results. That is what cfab is all about.What looks like a strong brand from the outside is powered by high performance, fast execution, and people who work with real intensity to drive our growth every day.As a Product & Packaging Compliance Manager (m/f/d) , you will make sure every product we sell in the EU and the US meets all product, packaging and labeling requirements, from fabric and care labels to cartons and polybags. You will turn regulatory text into clear requirements for our suppliers and teams, and release artwork and packaging before production.You will work closely with Buying, Product, our sourcing team, suppliers and external legal and EPR partners. At the same time, you will establish the processes, standards and controls that make compliance work consistently across all our brands and markets.YOUR IMPACT• Monitor, interpret and implement EU and US product, packaging and labeling legislation, including GPSR, the EU Textile Labelling Regulation, EU packaging law (PPWR, national EPR) and US FTC textile, care and country-of-origin labeling rules• Own materials, packaging and labeling compliance for every product, from fabric, cartons and polybags to hangtags, care labels and product labels, including importer and manufacturer identification and traceability• Review and release supplier artwork and packaging proofs before production and before shipment• Establish governance processes, standards and controls so requirements are applied consistently across brands, suppliers and markets• Act as internal counterpart to external legal counsel and EPR/packaging registration partners• Maintain technical documentation and compliance records, including GPSR Responsible Person duties and retention obligations• Manage non-conformities with suppliers, from root cause analysis to corrective actions, and train Buying, Product and the sourcing team on requirementsWHY YOU WOULD BE A GOOD FIT FOR US• Degree or vocational training in Law, Textile or Product Management, Supply Chain Management, Business or a related field, or comparable practical experience in product compliance• Work experience in a similar position, ideally in apparel, textiles or consumer goods sold in the EU and US• Ability to read and apply regulatory text directly, not only checklists, and turn it into clear requirements for suppliers and teams• Hands-on experience with artwork and packaging approval processes• Working knowledge of HS/TARIC classification is a plus• Structured and detail-focused, with a good mix of analytical and operational thinking• Fluent German and English• Willingness to work from our headquarters in Düsseldorf at least 4 days per weekWHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT CFAB• Permanent employment contract• 31 vacation days• Flexible working hours• Apple equipment (MacBook, iPhone)• Employer-paid team lunch three times a week• Monthly tax-free benefits of your choice• Corporate Benefits and discounts• Manicure and barber appointments at the office• Monthly product vouchers• Optional company car after the probation period• Personal birthday voucher• Regular team events and celebrations• Plenty of room for your own ideas, ownership and active contributionWHAT MOTIVATES USAt cfab ambition and speed go hand in hand with high standards for our work. We don’t just want to develop ideas: we want to bring them to life quickly and see what comes of them. For us, it’s not just about good ideas, but above all about the results they produce.Our growth is driven by people who set high standards, drive things forward, and want to grow alongside us. Here you’ll have the space to take on responsibility, develop your skills, and make your own impact visible.READY TO CREATE WHAT’S NEXT?Let’s make it happen.

jobs.description: Position available from:Position to be filled immediatelyLOCATIONDörth, Germany / hybridEMPLOYMENTFull-time / PermanentFUNCTIONProject DeliveryTHE ROLEOnce a customer contract is signed, you take end-to-end responsibility for project delivery, working closely with the customer and cross-functional teams across Engineering, Finance and Production.You combine customer focus with commercial project management and technical coordination. engineering, interfaces, schedule, suppliers, construction, acceptance or commercial performance – and drive pragmatic solutions before they become critical.YOUR PROFILE We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the realities of plant engineering, EPC environments or complex capital projects.You will have the following essential skills:• Several years (min. 3-5) of experience in project management, project execution, commercial project management or contract management within plant engineering, EPC, industrial equipment, infrastructure or a comparable capital-project environment.• Experience working across several stages of the capital-project lifecycle, ideally including engineering, manufacturing, procurement, site execution, commissioning and project close-out.• A strong commercial understanding of project contracts, payment milestones, budgets, guarantees, change orders and claim management.• Sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly structured and independent working style, combined with the ability to remain effective when projects become complex or situations change quickly.• Strong negotiation and communication skills and the confidence to address difficult project issues directly.• A degree in engineering, industrial engineering, business administration or a comparable discipline – or equivalent professional experience gained in industrial project environments.• Professional-level (C1) German and English skills is required; additional languages are an advantage. • Willingness to travel internationally when required by the project.Experience with pyrolysis, biochar or carbon removal is welcome, but not required. jobs.employer_name: Rheinland-Pfälzische Techn. Univers. Kaiserslautern-Landau Standort Landau
jobs.description: With about 15,000 students, more than 300 professorships and around 160 degree programs, the RPTU University Kaiserslautern-Landau is the technical university of the state of Rhineland-Palatinate. As a place of top international research, it offers excellent working conditions and career opportunities. Those who study, research or work at RPTU experience a cosmopolitan environment and shape the future.As part of the DFG-funded project Energy Structures: Energy Sustains Dissipative Structures in Soil Systems (https://soilsystems.net/projects-partners/2-p1-energy-structures/), the RPTU in Landau and the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) in Leipzig jointly offer a PhD position.Place of work: 50% at RPTU in Landau (32.5%) and 50% at UFZ in Leipzig (32.5%), according to agreement and project requirementsYour area of responsibility:The aim of the project is to understand how and under which conditions carbon and energy are transformed and stored in soils. Through incubation experiments and thermodynamic modelling, you will quantify matter and energy fluxes and characterize their efficiency and limitations. In doing so, you will investigate how energy inputs from organic substrates affect dissipative processes in soil microbial communities and whether dissipative structures develop in soils that govern matter and energy fluxes and thereby promote soil carbon storage.To achieve this aim, you will primarily work with a newly developed calorespirometric system at RPTU in Landau, which you will also further develop. In Leipzig, you will work with a newly developed plug-flow reaction calorimeter at UFZ. The measurements will be complemented by key chemical and biological analyses of the soil and its microbial community, including isothermal microcalorimetry (IMC), thermogravimetry–differential scanning calorimetry–quadrupole mass spectrometry (TG-DSC-QMS), phospholipid fatty acid (PLFA) analyses, elemental analyses and molecular biological analyses.The project is part of the DFG Priority Programme SPP 2322 SoilSystems (https://soilsystems.net/). You will benefit from the interdisciplinary collaboration within the programme's nationwide research consortium. Close collaboration, in particular with Trier University, is also planned.We offer:- Top-level research at the interface between research centre and university, with an excellent reputation nationally and internationally- The opportunity to benefit from the expertise of two research institutions- Excellent technical infrastructure and equipment- Work in interdisciplinary and international teams- Excellent connections to national and international research networks- Comprehensive support and optimal training courses by our graduate schools (HIGRADE at UFZ and ZGaPL at RPTU)- Salary according to the German public sector pay scale TVöD/TV-L, pay grade E13 (65%)Your requirements profile:- Master's degree or equivalent in soil science, environmental sciences, biochemistry, biology, chemistry, or a related field- Strong interest in complex and interdisciplinary processes in soil systems- Interest, willingness and ability to integrate new scientific concepts into soil science research- Prior experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage, but not a prerequisite: soil science, environmental microbiology, calorimetry, and thermodynamics; Willingness to expand your expertise into complementary fields is expected- Curiosity and openness to learning new methods, critically evaluating and further developing existing approaches, and exploring new methodological solutions- Willingness to independently learn new methods, troubleshoot and develop creative solutions to methodological challenges- Openness to incorporating modelling approaches and aspects of microbial ecology into your research- Willingness to work in an interdisciplinary and international team- Very good written and spoken English skillsMore informations given on our homepage:https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/f03b170329d9425cfa5355ad0c4fe4ba72fea9bb0 (https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/f03b170329d9425cfa5355ad0c4fe4ba72fea9bb0)We look forward to receiving your detailed application (CV, references, etc.) by 15.11.2026 at the latest.The job interviews are scheduled to take place in calendar weeks 48 and 49.Deutsche Version:Die Rheinland-Pfälzische Technische Universität Kaiserslautern-Landau (RPTU) ist mit rund 15.000 Studierenden, mehr als 300 Professuren und rund 160 Studiengängen die Technische Universität des Landes Rheinland-Pfalz. Als Ort internationaler Spitzenforschung bietet sie exzellente Arbeitsbedingungen und Karrierechancen. Wer an der RPTU lernt, forscht oder arbeitet, erlebt ein weltoffenes Umfeld und gestaltet die Zukunft.Im Rahmen des von der DFG geförderten Projekts Energy Structures: Energy Sustains Dissipative Structures in Soil Systems (https://soilsystems.net/projects-partners/2-p1-energy-structures/) bieten die RPTU in Landau und das Helmholtz-Zentrum für Umweltforschung (UFZ) in Leipzig gemeinsam eine Promotionsstelle an.Arbeitsort: je zur Hälfte an der RPTU in Landau (32,5 %) und am UFZ in Leipzig (32,5%) nach Absprache und inhaltlicher Notwendigkeit.Ihr Aufgabengebiet:Ziel des Projektes ist es, zu verstehen, wie und unter welchen Bedingungen Kohlenstoff und Energie im Boden transformiert und gespeichert werden. Durch Inkubationsexperimente und thermodynamische Modellierung quantifizieren Sie die Stoff- und Energieflüsse und beschreiben deren Effizienz und Grenzen. Sie erforschen dadurch, wie der Energieeintrag durch organische Substrate dissipative Prozesse in mikrobiellen Gemeinschaften des Bodens beeinflusst und ob sich im Boden dissipative Strukturen ausbilden, welche Stoff- und Energieflüsse im Boden bestimmen und dadurch Kohlenstoffspeicherung im Boden fördern.Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, arbeiten Sie schwerpunktmäßig mit einem neu entwickelten kalorespirometrischen System an der RPTU in Landau, das Sie auch weiterentwickeln werden. In Leipzig arbeiten Sie mit einem neu entwickelten Durchflussreaktionskalorimeter am UFZ in Leipzig. Die Messungen werden durch zentrale chemische und biologische Analysen des Bodens und seiner mikrobiellen Gemeinschaft ergänzt, unter anderem mittels isothermer Mikrokalorimetrie (IMC), Thermogravimetrie-Differenzkalorimetrie-Quadrupol-Massenspektrometrie (TG-DSC-QMS), PLFA-Analysen, Elementaranalysen und molekularbiologischer Analysen.Das Projekt ist Teil des DFG-Schwerpunktprogramms SPP 2322 „SoilSystems“ (https://soilsystems.net/). Sie profitieren von der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit des überregionalen Konsortiums des Schwerpunktprogramms, zudem ist eine enge Zusammenarbeit insbesondere mit der Universität Trier geplant.Wir bieten:- Spitzenforschung an der Schnittstelle von Universität und außeruniversitärer Forschung mit exzellentem nationalem und internationalem Ruf- Sie profitieren von der Expertise zweier Forschungseinrichtungen- Hervorragende technische Ausstattung- Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams- Sehr gute Anbindung an nationale und internationale Forschungsnetzwerke- Umfassende Betreuung und optimale Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch unsere Graduiertenschulen (HIGRADE am UFZ und ZGaPL an der RPTUUnser Anforderungsprofil:- Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master oder äquivalent - ausgenommen mit einem Bachelorgrad) der Bodenwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften, Biochemie, Biologie, Chemie oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet- starkes Interesse an komplexen und interdisziplinären Zusammenhängen in Bodensystemen- Interesse, Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit, in diesem Projekt neue naturwissenschaftliche Konzepte in die bodenwissenschaftliche Forschung zu integrieren- Vorerfahrungen in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung: Bodenkunde, Umweltmikrobiologie, Kalorimetrie und Thermodynamik; die Bereitschaft, die eigene Expertise auf komplementäre Fachgebiete auszuweiten, wird vorausgesetzt- Neugier und Offenheit, neue Methoden zu erlernen, bestehende Ansätze kritisch zu hinterfragen und weiterzuentwickeln sowie neue methodische Lösungen zu erkunden- Bereitschaft zum selbstständigen Einarbeiten, zur Fehlersuche und zur Entwicklung kreativer Lösungen für methodische Herausforderungen- Offenheit, Modellierungsansätze und Aspekte der mikrobiellen Ökologie in die eigene Forschung einzubeziehen- Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in einem interdisziplinären und internationalen Team- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und SchriftWeitere Informationen finden Sie auf unserer Homepage:https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/f03b170329d9425cfa5355ad0c4fe4ba72fea9bb0 (https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/f03b170329d9425cfa5355ad0c4fe4ba72fea9bb0)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.occupation: Ph.D. student (m/f/x): Data analysis for exotic hadrons at hadronic thresholds (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (26.2878 hours/week = 66%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1Ph.D. student (m/f/x): Data analysis for exotic hadrons at hadronic thresholdsThe work of the chair of experimental physics 1 focuses on basic research: Oneof the most essential elements of todays education and research is to gain abetter understanding of the structure of matter and the fundamental principles ofnature. In this process the basic research of physics plays an important role as itprovides a base for technical innovations and development. Hadron Physicsdeals with strong interacting particles consisting of quarks and gluons. Amongthose hadrons also rank the building blocks of the atomic nucleus, the protonand the neutron. There are many other hadrons that can only be created viacollisions of high energetic particles in big particle accelerators. The created hadrons are detected by modern and complex detectors to examine their composition and interactions.The position is embedded in two research programs. DEMOS ("Democratizing Models") is an ErUM research initiative developing a federated, interoperable standard for describing, sharing and re-evaluating physics models across particle, hadron, nuclear, neutrino and astroparticle physics. Hadronic coupled-channel amplitudes are one of its flagship applications: they are analytically intricate and rarely reproducible from the publication alone, which makes them an ideal test case for the new standard. HADRON 2030 is an intercollaborative research network dedicated to studies of hadron physics. Within the ExHAT (Exploration of Heavy Hadrons at Thresholds) project, we will explore heavy hadrons at thresholds using spectroscopy methods with LHCb data and inclusive production studies with ALICE. The flagship case is the doubly charmed tetraquark Tcc(3875)+, which lies a fraction of an MeV below the D0D*+ threshold. Line shape, pole position, three-body DD-pi dynamics and isospin breaking have to be disentangled in a joint effort of theory and experiment.Scope: part-timeDuration: fixed-term, 3 yearsStart: at the earliest possible dateApply by:  2026-11-15Your tasks:- Application of advanced methods of data selection, efficiency and resolutionstudies within LHCb data analysis.- Construction, fitting and analytic continuation of coupled-channel scatteringamplitudes.- Decipherment and serialization of the complex amplitudes in the DEMOS / amplitude-serialization format.- Collaboration within the DEMOS / HADRON 2030 networks.- Exchange with the experimental collaborations [LHCb, BESIII, Belle II, GlueX, ...] and with EFT/lattice QCD groups.Your profile:- Master's degree (or equivalent) in physics, completed by the starting date.- Background in experimental particle physics or hadron physics, and familiarity with quantum field theory and scattering theory.- Good scientific programming skills (Julia, Python or C++) and experience with version control and reproducible workflows.- Very good command of written and spoken English.- Interest in working at the interface between theory and experiment and inopen, reusable research software.https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/cfcd29d29c6781afa43ea9ee698bf39148ca1c4f0?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/cfcd29d29c6781afa43ea9ee698bf39148ca1c4f0?ref=AfA)

jobs.description: Background information about us:We are a German-owned company located in the Japanese area of Immermannstraße, Düsseldorf. Here we have three cafes focusing on Tapioca Drinks, homemade Mochi and Tayaki. All three stores offer job opportunities. Our staff is very international. We pay a bonus if we have good business or if you are working on the late shift or on a weekend day-        Customer tips-        At least two free days (or more) per week-        We do not break up your daily working time into lunch and dinner with very long time in between -        We are a German very staff friendly company and are proud of a good working climate and conditions, staff well-being is important to us-        Please apply in English language and provide your CV – we will then set up a line call with you to discuss further steps. Company DescriptionAbout usPassion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.Are you striving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!Job DescriptionThe LUCA programLUCA is METRO’s strategic SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation program. It safeguards business continuity and addresses security and compliance risks while enabling greater standardization, harmonization and centralization across Finance. Alongside new-country rollouts, the program continuously evolves and supports the productive solution used by countries already live on LUCA.Purpose of the roleBased in Düsseldorf, Germany, the SAP Finance Project Manager will lead the delivery of change projects for LUCA countries already operating on the productive SAP S/4HANA Finance solution. Typical assignments include the implementation of new electronic-invoicing mandates, other legal and regulatory requirements, and business-driven changes that affect Finance processes, integrations, data, controls and operational procedures.The role is designed for an experienced SAP Financials professional who has moved into project coordination and delivery management. The Project Manager must understand Finance requirements and SAP solution implications well enough to structure work, challenge plans, connect the correct experts and drive decisions, while remaining accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and stakeholder alignment in a large international SAP landscape.Your responsibilitiesEnd-to-end project delivery- Own the delivery of assigned SAP Finance projects for LUCA live countries from initiation and scoping through design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and closure.- Translate legal, regulatory and business change requests into structured projects with clear objectives, scope boundaries, deliverables, milestones, governance, resource needs and acceptance criteria.- Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering functional design, technical implementation, interfaces, data, testing, cutover, communication, training and operational readiness.- Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions and change control, ensuring that deviations are visible and addressed early.- Prepare concise status reporting, decisions and recommendations for LUCA governance, country stakeholders and management.Regulatory and business change delivery- Coordinate the implementation of country-specific electronic-invoicing mandates and other legal or tax-driven changes, working with Finance local, central, system implementors, and partner-system specialists.- Lead business-change projects that enhance or adapt live SAP Finance processes, ensuring alignment with the LUCA global template and the needs of productive operations.- Ensure requirements are sufficiently clear, approved and traceable, and that legal effective dates and business deadlines are translated into realistic delivery plans.- Coordinate impact assessments across SAP Finance, SAP Ariba where relevant, master data, reporting, authorizations, interfaces and non-SAP partner systems.- Protect productive operations by ensuring controlled releases, appropriate regression testing, cutover planning, support readiness and post-go-live monitoring.Functional and technical coordination- Use prior SAP Financials experience to understand end-to-end process impacts, ask informed questions and facilitate productive alignment between business and technology teams.- Coordinate solution architects, functional consultants, developers, integration teams, test teams, release management, AMS, country organizations and external partners.- Identify interdependencies across processes, systems, countries and concurrent initiatives, assign ownership and drive decisions and actions to closure.- Challenge delivery proposals, estimates and solution approaches constructively, while relying on accountable architects and specialists for detailed design authority.- Ensure project outputs are documented, supportable and handed over effectively to the relevant live-country and service-management organizations.Testing, deployment and stakeholder management- Work with LUCA Test Management to define the test approach, business participation, environments, data, entry and exit criteria, defect governance and acceptance evidence for each project.- Coordinate country UAT and business acceptance, ensuring the right stakeholders are mobilized and that open defects and residual risks are transparent before deployment.- Plan and govern cutover and production deployment activities with clear responsibilities, sequencing, readiness checks, fallback considerations and management communication.- Act as the central project contact for country Finance stakeholders, LUCA teams, METRO Digital, the System Integrator and other delivery partners.- Build trust across cultures and time zones through transparent communication, dependable follow-up, pragmatic issue resolution and timely escalation.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Informatics, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline.- At least 8 years of relevant experience in SAP Finance delivery, including substantial earlier experience in SAP Financials followed by a successful move into project coordination or project management.- Solid functional understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance processes and integration points, with experience in one or more areas such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Controlling, tax or financial interfaces.- Proven experience delivering SAP changes or projects in a large, international and multi-country SAP landscape.- Experience managing legal, regulatory, tax, electronic-invoicing or other deadline-driven change initiatives is highly advantageous.- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, country organizations, AMS providers, System Integrators and technology partners without relying solely on direct authority.- Experience across testing, UAT, cutover, release, deployment and hypercare in productive SAP environments.- Working knowledge of SAP Ariba, invoice-management solutions, integration platforms or partner-system landscapes is advantageous.- Confident use of project planning, collaboration and reporting tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint and Excel.- PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or SAP certification is advantageous but not required; retail or wholesale experience is beneficial.- Visible “can-do” attitude, with the energy and persistence to move complex topics forward, remove obstacles and find pragmatic paths to delivery.- Strong ownership and accountability, combined with disciplined planning, follow-up, risk management and escalation.- Ability to understand functional and technical discussions, structure ambiguity and translate complex issues into clear actions and decisions.- Confident, articulate communication and stakeholder-management skills across business, Finance, technology, vendors and senior management.- Collaborative and culturally aware working style suited to distributed international teams and multiple country stakeholders.- Calm and solution-oriented under pressure, particularly when managing fixed legal deadlines or production-critical changes.- Excellent written and spoken English; willingness and ability to travel when required.Additional Information**What do we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Project Manager Grade 3 (Md9).
